patch.summary: Perplexity cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Perplexity pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Perplexity cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Perplexity against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Pro, Max, Enterprise Pro)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, reasoning / advanced models, writing and paraphrasing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Research/citations are the core — weaker as a general coding or custom-GPT OS. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
